items.detail: The **Dow** fell 652.82 points (**1.23%**) to 52,215.16 Friday, its worst day since August, while the S&P 500 lost 0.52% to 7,623.68.
items.why: US crude topped $100 after Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and reports of new US-Israeli strike plans on Iran.

items.detail: The **Nasdaq** steadied after Thursday's rout, slipping just **0.21%** to 25,955.34 as some chip stocks bounced and CrowdStrike gained more than 8%.
items.why: With the AI selloff easing, oil-driven selling hit consumer and cyclical stocks harder than tech.

items.detail: Next week brings the **Fed** decision Wednesday, which is expected to be a pause, plus Microsoft and Alphabet results that day and Amazon on Thursday.
items.why: Their AI spending plans will show whether the costs worrying investors are starting to pay off.

items.detail: South Korea's **Kospi** recovered from an early 4% drop to close up **0.30%** at 5,550.30 Friday, and China's CSI 300 gained about 1.7%.
items.why: Bargain hunters bought back Samsung Electronics and SK hynix as fear over US AI spending faded.

items.detail: The **Nifty** fell 0.39% to **22,600** Friday, a fourth straight loss, while the Sensex shed 126 points to 73,123.83.
items.why: Crude jumping above $114 hurt India, a big oil importer, and pushed market fear higher.

items.detail: The US **Russell 2000** lost its safe-haven role Friday, falling about **0.3%** to roughly 2,776 after holding up during Thursday's tech rout.
items.why: Higher oil and rising long-term interest rates hurt smaller, more domestic companies.

items.detail: **Bitcoin** is holding around **$81,600** on Saturday, just above support near $81,000 after an attempt at $85,000 failed.
items.why: Spot bitcoin ETFs lost $635 million in a day, their biggest outflow since June, wiping out the earlier inflows.

items.detail: **Ether** slipped further to around **$2,364** on Saturday, down 0.7% in the past day and still below $2,500.
items.why: Ether ETFs lost another $110 million in a day, leaving the token with little buying support.

items.detail: **Solana** fell about **1.3%** to near $101.82 on Saturday, sliding further below its post-Alpenglow level.
items.why: Solana ETFs kept losing money, and the risk-off mood ahead of the Fed kept buyers away.

items.detail: **Gold** extended its slide Friday and briefly fell below **$4,000**, down about 0.8%, on track for a steep weekly loss.
items.why: Oil climbing on renewed Middle East tension strengthened expectations that the Fed will keep rates high.

crossCuttingTheme: Oil has replaced the AI scare as the main worry: crude above $100 on Iran and Houthi attacks is raising inflation and Fed-hike fears, hitting the Dow, India, small caps and gold together.
